name: Riolobos (Spain)
description: White field with a blue wavy stripe across the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Riolobos (two wolves and a wavy fess).
history: Municipal flag of Riolobos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Riolobos arms — two wolves and a wavy fess
